verdict.rationale: decK and kongctl provide declarative, bulk configuration management (sync entire API/gateway state from files) and the Admin API allows scripted bulk changes, which supports AI-native automation across many entities (routes, services, plugins) at once. However, evidence doesn't show bulk operations specifically framed for AI-native workflows (e.g., bulk operations on AI Models, MCP tools, or catalog entries) beyond general declarative config sync. missing for 10: explicit bulk operation APIs/examples for AI-specific entities (LLMs, MCP servers, agents), independent hands-on validation of bulk operation performance/reliability at scale.
